FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.settings.webhookUrl.name: Webhook URL
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.settings.webhookUrl.hint: The endpoint URL where document change events will be sent via POST request.
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.settings.apiSecret.name: API Secret
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.settings.apiSecret.hint: Shared secret used to generate an HMAC-SHA256 signature for each request. Your API can verify the X-Foundry-Signature header to ensure authenticity.
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.settings.debounceMs.name: Debounce Interval (ms)
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.settings.debounceMs.hint: How long to wait (in milliseconds) before sending batched changes. Lower values mean faster updates; higher values reduce request volume. Default: 2000.
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.settings.filterRules.hin: JSON configuration for which document types, subtypes, and operations to track.
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.settings.filterConfig.hi: Open the filter configuration to choose which document types, subtypes (e.g. character vs npc), and operations (create/update/delete) trigger webhook events.
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.notifications.sendFailed: Webhook: Failed to send events after {attempts} attempts.
FOUNDRY_WEBHOOK.notifications.noUrl: Webhook: No URL configured. Go to Module Settings to set up the webhook endpoint.
